purpose: Carry result-landing contracts for automatic meta-mission/provider operations while preserving std_meta_mission_queue as the mission-lane authority, provider_metabolism_ledger as the provider capacity authority, state/compute_workers as the receipt evidence root, and system/lib/launchable_operations.py as the command allowlist authority.
migration_rule: Keep only meta-mission/provider-owned landing metadata here. Inline into a future meta-mission/provider contract surface or the launch catalog when the owner surface is clean; do not use this file for reactions, metabolismd, dispatch-policy-only, or arbitrary launchable-operation contracts.

residual_routing.primary: provider receipt plus optional row_patch under state/compute_workers
residual_routing.failed_or_blocked: metabolism job last_error, provider cooldown/budget state, and state/metabolism/logs/<job_id>.log
residual_routing.queued_or_budget_vetoed: provider_metabolism_ledger and metabolismd launchable_operation_contracts report_only_warn status
residual_routing.follow_up_work: Task Ledger note/capture under cap_quick_launchable_operations_landing_surface_contract or the owning meta-mission WorkItem
residual_routing.promotion_boundary: controller/apply lane reviews row_patch artifacts before source, raw-seed, doctrine, or WorkItem mutation

result_landing_contract.produces: A bounded provider worker result for a transform_job, recorded as a provider_receipt and, when schema-valid candidate output exists, a draft row_patch.
result_landing_contract.success_signal: type_a_worker_harness exits 0; the metabolism job completes; the log emits artifact_refs.receipt; the provider_receipt has status=ok and validation_result.passed=true.
result_landing_contract.residual_signal: type_a_worker_harness exits nonzero, provider cooldown/budget gates block dispatch, input generation is stale/deleted/undeclared, receipt status is not ok, validation_result.passed=false, row_patch remains draft/pending_review, or the meta-mission queue still waits on provider output.

residual_routing.primary: materialized transform_job files plus enqueued provider_transform_job rows; provider receipts and row_patches are owned by the downstream provider_transform_job contract
residual_routing.failed_or_blocked: metabolism job last_error, state/metabolism/logs/<job_id>.log, and provider queue/budget state
residual_routing.queued_or_budget_vetoed: provider_transform_job jobs remain visible in metabolismd status/doctor and provider_metabolism_ledger until provider gates admit or block them
residual_routing.follow_up_work: Task Ledger note/capture under cap_quick_launchable_operations_landing_surface_contract when materialization stops producing queued transform jobs or provider jobs remain blocked
residual_routing.promotion_boundary: This operation may materialize provider transform_job packets and enqueue provider work. Provider receipts/row_patches remain draft evidence and require controller/apply review before raw-seed, source, doctrine, or WorkItem mutation.

result_landing_contract.produces: A bounded batch of raw-seed Type B provider candidate transform_job files, with matching provider_transform_job queue entries for NVIDIA/OpenRouter lanes.
result_landing_contract.success_signal: type_a_worker_harness.py materialize-row-jobs exits 0; log output reports materialized_count and enqueued_count; each materialized row carries provider_id, target_row_id, artifact_path, and authority_boundary=receipt_or_row_patch_only_until_controller_import.
result_landing_contract.residual_signal: harness exits nonzero, materialized_count or enqueued_count unexpectedly drops to zero while candidate rows exist, row-job source returns no fresh candidates without a no-op explanation, or queued provider_transform_job rows remain blocked by provider budget/cooldown gates.
